messages:
amanda (People Ops): Quick ask 4 tiny "goal-card" pack for managers and ICs — single paragraph goal, 3 micro-prompts, and two paste-ready self-review lines. Want to drop in templates and internal wiki. Thoughts?

 diego (Eng Manager): Love compact stuff. Can we include a sample for non-metric work (docs/research)?

 amanda (People Ops): Yup — draft below. Keep reactions short.

```
GOAL-CARD (one-paragraph)
- Statement: What we will deliver and who benefits. e.g. "Improve recommendations latency to reduce user wait time for mobile checkout, benefiting checkout funnels and retention."
- Success metric (one line): e.g. "p95 latency down 18% (420ms -> 344ms) and checkout conversion +0.7pp by EOY"
- Scope & constraints (one line): e.g. "Async batching + kernel tuning; depends on infra nodes; canary week 8"

MANAGER MICRO-PROMPTS (drop into 1:1)
- "What's the smallest ship that proves this will move the metric?"
- "If this slips, what do we deprioritize to keep our 2x committed work stable?"
- "What support/time do you need from me this sprint?"

PASTE-READY SELF-REVIEW LINES
- Outcome: "Reduced recs p95 latency 18% (420ms->344ms) leading to +0.7pp checkout conversion; rolled out canary week 8."
- Role & ask: "Led async batching + kernels; owned perf tests. Ask: 40 node-hours for final canary + pairing for kernel tuning."

NON-METRIC EXAMPLE (research/docs)
- Outcome: "Published 4 research notes synthesizing model failure modes; two product teams adopted mitigation patterns in sprints 5-6."
```

rachel (Data Scientist): This is great. Suggest we add a tiny "tagging" convention managers can paste so reviews and HC asks surface in Ops: e.g. append [HC-REQ] or [INFR-REQ].

ben (HR): Agree on tags. Also add a one-line privacy check reminder when work touches customer data: "If goal uses customer PII, confirm DSR & data retention steps with security."

amanda (People Ops): Good call. I'll add the tags and the privacy one-liner. Plan: publish to templates and pin in #people-ops by EOD. Thanks all! :sparkles: 

goalbot: Goal-card template uploaded: https://redwood.internal/templates/goal-card-pack-v1 (auto) :white_check_mark:

diego (Eng Manager): Will use in manager sync tomorrow. Short & practical.

amanda (People Ops): Noted action items: add tags [HC-REQ]/[INFR-REQ], add privacy reminder, include non-metric example. ETA EOD."
